evidence.r1: Glass only on the route picker, weather and Permits capsules (top) and the route menu; all controls.
evidence.r2: The selected 'Cascade Pass' row in the route menu is a fill, not glass (menu, both schemes).
evidence.r3: Three capsules over the hero, each a planner function the brief asks for.
evidence.r4: All three capsules and the menu are one frosted regular material in light and dark.
evidence.r5: No clear variant; the capsules blur the lake photo into a pale frost.
evidence.r7: Capsule bodies show the blurred landscape through them (light and dark).
evidence.r8: Capsule controls and a fixed-radius menu.
evidence.r9: The selected capsule row sits mid-menu, away from the menu's corners; nothing reads pinched.
evidence.r10: The floating buttons (route, weather, Permits) are capsules.
evidence.r11: The planner is split into three groups (route+distance, weather, permits), within the three-group limit.
evidence.r12: Each capsule is one labelled button, and the menu holds only text rows.
evidence.r13: Material sits on each capsule and on the menu, not on the labels inside.
evidence.r14: The three capsules sit at even ~48px gaps, deliberately separate, and the menu replaces the route capsule.
evidence.r15: The brief has the trail list scroll beneath the bar, but no capture shows a scrolled state or any edge effect; the stitched full page is a single viewport.
evidence.r16: At rest all three capsules sit over the lake-and-forest photo.
evidence.r17: The headline and body text begin below the hero, clear of the capsules.
evidence.r18: Dark labels on pale-blue glass reach ~9-10:1 (light); light labels on dark glass, including the menu's distances, reach ~5:1 (dark).
evidence.r19: Reduced capture: capsules turn opaque white and stay legible; the toggle shows on. Contrast and motion were not captured.
evidence.r20: The lake photo runs to the window edges at the top, with the capsules floating over it.
evidence.r21: The text column starts below the hero, clear of the bar; there is no sidebar.
evidence.r22: No backing under the capsules; the dark scheme dims the whole photo, not a layer under the bar.
evidence.r23: The route menu opens in place of the route capsule, and a pointer glow shows on 'Easy Pass' in the dark menu.
evidence.r24: Icons and labels on the capsules are monochrome; the purple accent and green status dot are in the content.
evidence.r25: Near-black labels on pale glass over green and teal; no label is close to the landscape colours.
